summary: Tested the 'Área do Candidato' header button and the new CPF lookup page. A real mouse click (or tap) at the button's center reached /minhas-inscricoes.html on all 6 pages (/, /analista.html, /assistente-administrativo.html, /termos.html?c=assistente, /termos.html?c=analista, /inscricao.html). Each run used a fresh anonymous context: 30 desktop runs (1920x1080, 1536x864, 1280x720, 1536x864@dsf1.25, 1280x720@dsf1.5), 6 mobile runs (390, hamburger menu, then tap), and runs at 1440, 1100 and 900 (900 via hamburger). The home modal does not block clicks once closed with aviso-importante-ok. On /minhas-inscricoes.html: 'Área do Candidato' title OK, CPF mask OK, invalid CPF message OK, CPF without registration shows 'Nenhuma inscrição encontrada para este CPF.', and a registered CPF (created via POST /api/track/registration) shows a card with name, Analista Jurídico and R$ 120,00. Clicking the card goes to /pagamento-pix.html?cpf=..., which loads the summary, saves it to localStorage and reloads without the query string. With pix_key empty the page shows 'Chave PIX não configurada' (expected). With a temporary pix_key it showed Nome, CPF, Cargo, R$ 120,00 and the QR/copy-paste code. The Voltar button goes to /. One layout bug: between about 992px and 1155px wide the header does not fit and the button sticks out of the right edge.

ui_bugs.component: Header (home and all pages with the shadow-DOM header)
ui_bugs.issue: Between about 992px and 1155px wide (for example a 1280px screen at 125% zoom = 1024 CSS px) the desktop header is shown but does not fit. The button 'ÁREA DO CANDIDATO' stays at x=972 with width 183 and goes past the right edge. At 1024px only the icon shows and the label is cut off, and the page scrolls sideways (scrollWidth 1156 on '/'). Clicking the visible part still navigates, but a click at the center of the element misses. This may be part of what the user saw ('não leva a lugar nenhum' with zoom). Fix: show the hamburger menu below about 1200px, or let the nav shrink/wrap so the button stays inside the viewport.

issues: When protocolo is empty, the card makes up a number 'Nº 2026' + last 6 CPF digits, but the PIX page shows 'Inscrição: —'. The two pages disagree; use the same fallback on both.

action_items: Fix the header overflow between about 992px and 1155px: switch to the hamburger menu, or shrink/wrap the nav so the 'ÁREA DO CANDIDATO' button stays fully visible (home/analista/assistente pages and the seduc-theme.js shadow header)
Optional: use the same inscrição number fallback on the Área do Candidato card and on the PIX page
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/inscricao/resumo/{cpf} is public and returns name and cargo for any CPF without a second factor (such as birth date). This lets anyone look up data by CPF; consider asking for DATA_NASC as well.
minhas-inscricoes.html: the CPF is only checked for 11 digits, with no check-digit validation (the PIX page already has a validator).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested viewports pass; the 992-1155px overflow is a layout bug outside the requested sizes)

seed_data_creation: Created a test registration with CPF 52998224725 (TEST_AREA CANDIDATO, Analista Jurídico). It has been deleted (inscricao and cadastro). pix_key was set to 'teste@exemplo.com' for a moment and then reset to empty. Raw rows in the 'registrations' log collection remain because there is no single-row delete endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use browser.new_context per run for anonymous tests. Close the home modal with aviso-importante-ok. The mobile hamburger is data-testid=mobile-menu-toggle, either in the normal DOM or in the #seduc-header-host shadow root. The pagamento-pix ?cpf= deep link hydrates localStorage and then reloads with location.replace (the query string disappears; this is expected). Admin settings: PUT /api/admin/settings {pix_key}.
